d: The Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) has sentenced 61 soldiers to death reportedly after a 12-day military trial. According to local media reports, the troops were convicted of abandoning their positions and fleeing clashes with armed fighters in North Kivu, as the army battles rebel groups, including M23. The latest sentences come amid a wider crackdown, with at least 507 soldiers convicted and 381 handed death sentences since 2025.
